manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the metal can fits easily in hand, put it in the medium basket with smooth texture, lift the medium basket with smooth texture.

Task description: Put the red-and-white metal can on the right side of the image into the smooth orange-brown medium basket at the center, then lift the basket containing the can.

Success criteria: The metal can must remain inside the basket, near and physically touching its body, with no table contact. Both basket and can must be clearly raised above their starting positions, with the basket opening upright and without excessive tilt. Merely putting the can in a basket still resting on the table is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Grip opposite middle can sides with pads clear of the top rolled rim and bottom edge, opening slightly wider than its diameter. Confirm the fingers surround it before closing to avoid toppling or off-center grasping.
- There is a handle above the basket opening. When placing the can, use the gap between the handles and leave clearance for both the can body and fingers to avoid hitting a handle with the base or catching on the rim.
- Release the can only after its bottom is supported by the basket. When withdrawing the fingers, watch for the handle and rim to avoid tipping the can during unsupported release or shifting the basket with the gripper.
- To lift the basket, grasp an upper handle arc away from the rim that the fingers can surround. Set the opening to its thickness and grasp near the top center to reduce tilt from an off-center pull.
- When lifting the basket with the can inside, change height and direction smoothly, keep the opening facing upward, and check whether the can remains inside. Avoid shaking it out.
